relevant_tags.why: This is the advertiser's core product category.
Vitamins are a highly related adjacent category to athletic supplements.
Athletes and fitness-engaged shoppers who buy activewear are highly likely to use performance supplements.
Consumers purchasing from DTC wellness brands are aligned with premium self-care products.
